issues.description: Symbol visibility/export mismatch: the template declares the program entry as global main (template: 'global main' at the top of pixel.asm), while the solution file exports 'global _start' but actually defines the label 'main'. This makes the solution inconsistent with the template's expected exported symbol and may cause linking/visibility problems or confuse students about which symbol should be made global.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the template by exporting the same symbol the template expects. Replace 'global _start' in solution/pixel.asm with 'global main' (or alternatively define a matching '_start' label if that was intended). Ensure the exported global label matches the defined entry label so the assembled object links and matches the template's expectations.
